svg.title: Hypothetical 20-step ticket, three bills
svg.desc: Worked example, not a measurement. Same stated token counts, OpenAI standard rates, uncached, under 272K input. All Astra $1.840. Sol on 12 glue steps and 6 draft steps, Astra on 2 hard steps: $0.868. All Sol $0.460. Bar lengths follow those totals. Glue, draft, and hard segments are labelled.
